name: Autodrom Sosnová v8 - Standard circuit
description: Autodrom Sosnová near Česká Lípa, Czech Republic. Geometry from the Czech state orthophoto and lidar models (ČÚZK): all asphalt of the complex, gravel run-offs, the green arch bridge, buildings with real heights, barriers, pylons. Surfaces are photo-scanned materials and the trees are pictures of scanned 3D trees (Poly Haven, CC0). The timed lap is the standard circuit, turns 1 to 12, anticlockwise. 16 grid slots, 16 pit boxes, AI line. Optional CSP grass and rain. Not affiliated with the circuit owner.
author: Sosnova track kit (data: ČÚZK Ortofoto ČR + DMR 5G, CC BY 4.0)
